name: Gordunni Cobalt
summary: At Gordunni Outpost, blue glimmers in the dirt draw Orwin Gizzmick’s eye. He hopes the buried cobalt will fetch a fine price.

sections.title: Blue in the Dirt
sections.body: Orwin Gizzmick has newly arrived in Feralas and wants samples of the mineral the Gordunni ogres bury at their outpost. He lends you his shovel and points you north from Camp Mojache. Look for the blue glow among the dirt mounds; Orwin wants the cobalt for its value to a buyer.

faq.answer: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants twelve samples of Gordunni Cobalt.

faq.q: Where can I find Gordunni Cobalt?
faq.answer: The cobalt lies in dirt mounds at Gordunni Outpost, north of Camp Mojache in Feralas.
The Gordunni ogres bury the mineral to keep others from getting their hands on it.

faq.q: What does Orwin want the cobalt for?
faq.answer: Orwin hopes to find someone who will pay a fine price for the cobalt.
